other_mother_events_family_game_night_la.text: How considerate of you to finally join us. We've been sitting here waiting, sweetheart. I hope whatever kept you away was terribly important.
other_mother_events_family_game_night_la.direction: Forced sweetness over restrained irritation; deliberate and watchful, never shouting or monstrous.

note: Acting uses model emotion vectors. Human listening review is still required.
